scope: Post-evaluation descriptive audit of pop and ambient source-label false positives on all 204 observed songs.

definitions.fp: Source target is zero and existing application selected the label.
definitions.tn: Source target is zero and existing application did not select the label.
definitions.tp: Source target is one and existing application selected the label.
definitions.fn: Source target is one and existing application did not select the label.
definitions.source_negative: No source genre matches the frozen broad-label ontology; not verified absence of the audible style.
definitions.source_positive: At least one source genre matches the frozen broad-label ontology; not new human adjudication.
definitions.tag_prevalence_ratio: FP tag share divided by all-source-negative tag share; reference negatives include the FPs.
definitions.margin: Continuous distance above the already frozen threshold; no new classification cutoffs are selected.
definitions.sparsity: Count of available genre tags only. Few tags do not establish missing or incorrect annotations.

fp.interpretation: Descriptive observed-loss partition; source_negative/source_positive overlap the four confusion groups.

tn.interpretation: Descriptive observed-loss partition; source_negative/source_positive overlap the four confusion groups.

source_positive.interpretation: Descriptive observed-loss partition; source_negative/source_positive overlap the four confusion groups.

manual_review_candidates.rule: Three largest and three smallest positive existing-threshold logit margins; ties by track ID. No listening performed.
